whenToUse: Most choices are nearby dates, such as a delivery date or deadline.
Mobile screens where opening a calendar is a hassle.
People think of dates in words (this weekend).
whenNotToUse: Dates are spread evenly (use a date picker).
It would be unclear which date a chip means (show the real date too).

alternatives.name: Date Picker
alternatives.reason: Choosing any day on a calendar.

accessibility: Chips are aria-pressed buttons, so the chosen chip is read out.
Show the result again as a real date, such as "Arrives Sat, November 28", so people can check what "this weekend" means.
Other dates are chosen with a native date input.
Group the chips with role="group" and a name.
